# One night against base's mobs on the curve (generated by tools/progression/gen_night.py; edit that).
# A Stone Age player (flint spear, no armour) at the closed end of a roofed 3x3 lane, facing -z;
# a wave at the far end every minute, dusk to dawn. Read run.log: `mob_fight:` lines (hits both
# ways, deaths), `op health` answers, `expect alive` misses (one per wave the player ended dead).
# Each wave starts healed, the last wave cleared; a dead player respawns within 10 swings. Mob spawning off.
loaded
idle
chat /rule core:mob_spawning 0
chat /tk mode spectator
chat /tp 0.5 206 -0.5
wait 2
loaded
chat /tk fill -6 196 -30 6 204 4 stone
chat /tk fill -1 200 -25 1 202 -1 core:air
chat /tk fill -6 205 -30 6 215 4 core:air
wait 1
chat /time set 12000
chat /tk mode survival
chat /tp 0.5 200 -0.5
chat /gear spear flint slot=0
wait 1
chat /tk heal
look 0 -8
where night_start
op health
shot night_start.png
